findings.text: The report omits generated constants whose parent chain ends in a reported constant, although the extractor records their names and cause in `counts.json`. Fix: Build the reported-cause table from each snapshot file version’s stored `reported` entries and test it with `_private.M.0.match_1.eq_1` and its reported parent.

A missing facts directory or one left by an incremental run silently produces empty or partial rule counts alongside counts for the full snapshot. Fix: Check that the facts cover every module of the requested snapshot before printing and add a test with one module missing.

Splitting on every dot groups the private root name `_private.M.0.«a.match_1»` as `match_N»` and loses its private-root marker. Fix: Use Lean name-component boundaries for both the shape and the private-root check, and test a quoted component containing a dot.
The sample test checks only its length, so it passes if the report omits the text or selects the wrong declaration. Fix: Assert the expected hash-selected target and its stored text.
The report silently limits each declaration’s text to 400 characters, which can omit the part a reviewer needs to inspect. Fix: Include the full stored text for each sampled declaration.
`json.loads` leaves candidate rows and their fields typed as `Any` throughout counting, sampling, and text lookup. Fix: Decode each candidate into a typed record with explicit field types.

The status says the fourth-round findings are listed as owner questions, but this revision contains only the review and its deferral records. Fix: Link to review `20261122T135558Z-7e390e7e` and state that its five findings were deferred for owner review.
